sloka: वायसाः सघशः क्रूरा व्याहरन्ति समन्ततः ।समवेताश्च दृश्यन्ते विमानाग्रेषु सम्घशः ॥६-१०-१९॥।।
transliteration: vāyasāḥ saghaśaḥ krūrā vyāharanti samantataḥ ।samavetāśca dṛśyante vimānāgreṣu samghaśaḥ ॥6-10-19॥।।

translations.english: Wild crows are seen in flocks all over the top of aerial chariot sounding harsh gathered in groups.
